_about: The logging lesson 16.1 asks for. Each key is one telemetry source the simulator writes only if it is true here.
name: hardened
_cloudtrail_data_events: Advanced event selectors for AWS::BedrockMantle::Project, AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Runtime and ::Gateway, and S3 object-level events on the knowledge base source bucket only.
_invocation_logs: Text only, 30-day retention, KMS. The app passes end_user and session in requestMetadata (caller-supplied: trust it only from your own backend).
_app_log_identity: Request ID, signed-in user, session ID, runtime session ID, and token counts per request.
